_about: Shipped defaults for request-guard. Machine-local overrides go in ~/.claude/request-guard/config.json (same keys; objects merge, lists add, values replace; CLAUDE_REQUEST_GUARD_CONFIG points elsewhere). Limits are per site (registrable domain) and per machine, shared by every session and subagent. Keys left empty here: deny (suffixes never contacted, e.g. ["competitor.example"]), never_send (terms that must never appear in a header, URL or body, e.g. an own e-mail name), sensitive_terms (terms kept out of headers, e.g. a project name), trusted_scripts (path patterns of scripts the guard does not read because they pace themselves, e.g. ["~/tools/*.py"]). Put personal values in the machine-local file, not here.

default._about: Any public site not listed under hosts: a person's reading pace.

careful._about: Sites tied to an account or quick to challenge automation: search engines, social networks.

bulk._about: Public data services and large documentation sites built for programmatic or heavy reading. Conservative figures, not taken from each service's terms.

archive._about: The Internet Archive. Slower than bulk: on 2026-09-29 it answered 429 after about 27 requests sent 2 to 3 seconds apart.

infra._about: Developer infrastructure (code hosts, package registries, the model provider). High ceiling so only a runaway loop is caught; not counted toward total_per_hour.

hosts._about: suffix -> profile name, or "private" (never counted). Longest matching suffix wins.
